XENOPHYTE: Tendrils of a Dying Sun

Players2–4
Age10+
Time25–40 min

You are xenoflora escaping your dying homeworld. Spread across the galaxy, competing for control of new Solar Systems.

Components

  • 84× Species Dice (multicolored d6)
  • 12× Anomaly Dice (black d6)
  • 1× Grid (11×11)
  • Galaxy Maps
  • 9× Sun Marbles
  • 9× Asteroid Tokens
  • 9× Dead Space Cubes

Setup

  • Prepare the Galaxy: Put a map beneath the 11×11 grid. Place Suns, Asteroids, and Dead Space in their marked locations.
  • Choose Species: Take your color’s dice and arrange in groups of 3 (see table).
  • Prepare Anomalies: Each player rolls 3 Anomaly Dice. Keep them nearby, preserving their values.
  • First Player: Most recently saw a Venus Flytrap (or roll a d6).

Your turn

Play clockwise from the first player. Each turn, roll 3 Species Dice and place all three (see Placement Rules), optionally placing 1-3 remaining Anomaly Dice in any order.

Unused Anomaly Dice remain available for later turns.

Placement rules

  • Starting Point: Place the game’s first die on the Starting World marked on the map.
  • Adjacency: Every later die must be placed orthogonally (share an edge) with at least one existing die, regardless of color. Paired Wormholes also provide a connection.
  • Value: A placed die must be exactly ±1 from every orthogonally adjacent die, regardless of color. A 4 can touch a 3 or 5, but not a 2 or another 4. 1 and 6 do not wrap.
  • Legal Placement: Place all Species Dice in any order. After placing your other dice, reroll any Species Dice that cannot be placed until they can. Never reroll Anomaly Dice.

Galaxy features

  • Starting World: First die goes here.
  • Suns: Surround them to score.
  • Asteroids: Place any die here to collect the token; leave the die in that space.
  • Dead Space: Dice cannot be placed here
  • Wormholes: Once either is occupied, its pair acts as adjacent. Any player can use it, obeying ±1 with the linked die and every neighbor at the destination.

Scoring · after the final round

After the number of rounds indicated in the setup table (5-7) calculate the score using Victory Points (VP) using the following rules

  • Sun Adjacency: 1 VP per Species Die of your color in a Sun’s eight surrounding spaces. A die can score for multiple Suns.
  • Sun Majority: 3 extra VP per Sun where you have the most surrounding Species Dice. No bonus for ties.
  • Asteroids: Score 2 VP for each token collected.
  • Anomaly Dice earn no Sun adjacency points and do not count toward majority.

Victory: The player(s) with the most points win!
